candidates.full: DUBLIN, Ireland, November 12. Europe needs to make greater use of technological developments to strengthen its innovation capacity and boost competitiveness while building on its skilled workforce and strong business sector, Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin said, Trend's special correspondet reports. He made the remarks while summarizing the European Political Community (EPC) summit in Dublin. "We all recognise the need to focus on Europe's competitiveness, but we should not lose sight of our strengths, our capacity to innovate, the skills of our people, the strength and vibrancy of our enterprise sectors," he said. According to Martin, summit participants reaffirmed their commitment to leveraging technological developments to strengthen Europe's innovation capacity. He also highlighted the need for closer cooperation in preventing and responding to hybrid threats, including those targeting democratic processes. The prime minister stressed that European countries should share their experiences and work together to protect democratic institutions against attempts to sow division and undermine public confidence. Martin also reaffirmed Europe's unwavering support for Ukraine and expressed hope for a swift achievement of peace.

candidates.title: Sony Bets on Homegrown Anime to Fuel Decades of Future Growth
candidates.summary: Sony Bets on Homegrown Anime to Fuel Decades of Future Growth From the Walkman and PlayStation to Spider-Man’s box office records, Sony Group Corp. has shown a knack for shaping global pop culture hits. Now in the midst of a strategic transition, the company is pouring time and money into a homegro
candidates.full: Sony Bets on Homegrown Anime to Fuel Decades of Future Growth From the Walkman and PlayStation to Spider-Man’s box office records, Sony Group Corp. has shown a knack for shaping global pop culture hits. Now in the midst of a strategic transition, the company is pouring time and money into a homegrown genre with the potential to power growth for decades to come: anime. After turning Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba into a global phenomenon, the company is working to seed or acquire the next anime blockbuster. Some 80 years into its history, Sony is determined to create franchises that will last about as long. The $28 billion anime industry is one of the fastest growing genres of entertainment globally. For Sony, it’s a key part of a broader shift away from relying on physical hardware like the PlayStation console and toward IP and content. Much as with beloved game characters transcending their original format, hit anime franchises become gold mines not only for viewership but also for merchandise, music and live experiences. “With Demon Slayer, it is our intent to make this last 10 or 20, if not 50 to 100 years,” Atsuhiro Iwakami, president of Sony Music Entertainment Japan and chairman of Aniplex, Sony’s anime production company, said in an interview. He points to Dragon Ball and One Piece, stories that have survived long enough to pass from parents to children and which Sony has rights to stream internationally. “We want to make sure we’re part of creating the type of franchise that can withstand decades.” Tokyo-based Sony has turned anime into a scalable business in recent years with acquisitions of services like Crunchyroll, now the world’s largest streaming platform dedicated to the genre. It’s become a go-to destination for fans, who’ve grown from a niche group to a much larger contingent with the help of various celebrities and music artists embracing the genre. Read: Anime Is Grabbing More of Young Fans’ Entertainment Time The proof of the concept for Sony came with the Demon Slayer saga, depicting the adventures of a young swordsman battling demons while trying to restore his cursed sister to human form. Its 2020 movie, Mugen Train, became Japan’s highest-grossing film, dethroning Studio Ghibli’s 2001 classic Spirited Away. Five years later, the first installment of Demon Slayer’s Infinity Castle trilogy grossed about $800 million worldwide, demonstrating that a franchise born from Japanese manga could become a global theatrical blockbuster. The distinctly Japanese aesthetic and storytelling style, far from hampering international appeal, was a big part of the attraction. At the center of Sony’s push to do more with anime is Iwakami, who’s been with Aniplex since its inception and has helped shape its trajectory over almost three decades. He’s part of the strategic collaboration inside Sony to turn Aniplex and Crunchyroll into a complementary duo, where one produces and the other distributes original content. Iwakami’s defining bet was to combine the visual craftsmanship of ufotable, a studio known for spectacular anime aimed at what he calls “geeks or nerds,” with the mass appeal of manga from Weekly Shonen Jump. That experiment delivered Demon Slayer. The underlying Demon Slayer IP still belongs to Japan’s century-old manga publisher Shueisha, whose titles also include One Piece, Dragon Ball and Naruto. Asked whether Sony might invest in closely held Shueisha to gain greater access to its rich IP, Iwakami left the possibility open. “Perhaps, if the opportunity presents itself,” he said. Japanese entertainment companies are often competitors and collaborators at the same time, making takeover deals complicated. “So it’s not necessarily the case that just because we want to buy something, we can actually make that happen,” Iwakami said. “But if timing and chance align, we would certainly be open to entertaining different types of M&A.” Sony’s taking steps toward becoming an IP powerhouse. Last year, it became the largest shareholder in Kadokawa, owner of a vast library of manga, novels and games. It’s also trying to create more IP from scratch. Securing the franchises and storylines that build enduring appeal is becoming increasingly competitive as streaming giants such as Netflix Inc. and Walt Disney Co. also compete for anime licensing deals. Aniplex and Crunchyroll formed a new studio, Hayate, focused on developing and producing original anime for global audiences. The two also announced plans to adapt more stories into Japanese anime and live action by collaborating with homegrown creators, giving Sony another route to build franchises. The logic is straightforward. Anime has traditionally relied heavily on production committees, where publishers, studios, broadcasters and other partners share the cost, risk and rights. Greater control of the foundational IP could give Sony more freedom, and potentially more of the economic upside, as it takes a hit story across streaming, games, music, merchandise and live experiences. Sony put that ambition on display in New York in October. On the eve of New York Comic Con, about 500 creators, executives and other industry players gathered at the Javits Center for Crunchyroll’s first Anime Future Forum. Sony Chief Executive Officer Hiroki Totoki opened the event, flanked by executives from PlayStation, Sony Pictures as well as Iwakami. Director James Gunn, actor Samuel L. Jackson and musician Big Sean took part in discussions. The message was clear: Anime is becoming a central piece of Sony’s effort to knit together its sprawling entertainment businesses. The audience Sony's chasing filled the convention center. Fans of Nintendo Co.’s Super Mario, orange-clad Naruto followers and stormtroopers in full uniform mingled with One Piece pirates in straw hats and sword-carrying Tanjiros from Demon Slayer. Elaborate wigs, capes and prop weapons bobbed through the crowds as thousands of fans descended on Comic Con. Japanese anime, once a niche, spilled into every corner of the venue. Sony has more ways than most rivals to turn that fandom into a business. Aniplex can produce anime; Crunchyroll, with 21 million paid subscribers, can take it to viewers around the world; PlayStation can turn anime into games or games into anime; and Sony Music’s core operations can extend franchises into soundtracks, concerts and merchandise, helping to turn a successful anime into something much larger than a television show or movie. “Anime has a high affinity with the film and gaming businesses, making it an important sector for Sony as it aims to grow as an entertainment platform,” said Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Masahiro Wakasugi. “Furthermore, anime theme songs may positively contribute to Sony's music business, and the IP of anime protagonists can serve as medium- to long-term assets. Alongside games, music, and movies, anime is expected to hold an essential position as entertainment content.” Iwakami is also ready to imagine an audience beyond the action-heavy anime that fueled much of the industry’s global rise. He wants to explore animation for children and families, pointing to Bluey and Japan’s Chiikawa as examples. Sony has also increased its ownership of Peanuts Holdings to 80%, giving it control of Snoopy and other characters with appeal across generations and markets. Read: Japan’s Popular Chiikawa Understands Our Modern Anxieties Even a Sony theme park — like Disney or Universal’s — is a possibility. “To make a theme park, I think having control of IP is a prerequisite and necessary,” Iwakami said. If Sony eventually has enough demand and enough control of its characters, “then we can look into something that big.” But before Sony can extend anime into ever bigger businesses, it faces a more basic constraint: Japan is struggling to make enough of it. Looking back to twenty years ago, Iwakami recalls an anime could go from planning to broadcast in about a year — but today it can take three to four years. Skilled animators are scarce, costs have risen and the painstaking human craftsmanship that gives Japanese animation its distinctive character makes production difficult to accelerate. Sony is investing in training young animators while engaging with local governments on ways to build infrastructure for developing talent, Iwakami said. He also sees technology as part of the answer. He is cautious about generative artificial intelligence, saying it should support the artists behind anime rather than displace them. “There will be tools that will assist,” he said. “But it is not our goal to replace any of these creators.” That willingness to experiment has defined Iwakami’s career. A Hollywood movie fanatic and Gundam fan who collected Gunpla models, he says Sony has given young producers unusual freedom to test ideas. Early in his career, he thought less like a corporate executive than an individual producer pursuing projects that seemed fun and worth trying. Three decades later, he is trying to preserve that culture on a much larger stage. “Sony has always been intertwined with the evolution of technology and entertainment,” Iwakami said. He wants to see the company spark another unpredictable leap in the tradition of the PlayStation, which Sony's domestic music arm helped bring about by merging its entertainment mindset with hardware engineering. “It’s my hope that someone among the ranks will emerge and take on a new challenge that will produce results and grow the business in areas that you and I can’t predict.” Read: The Most Beloved Anime Studio Hasn’t Quite Sketched Out a Future

candidates.title: SpaceX wins Pentagon deal to test Starlink lasers for missile tracking
candidates.summary: - The Space Development Agency awarded SpaceX $9.9 million to study using its Plaser laser terminal for missile warning and tracking satellites. - The study includes representative hardware and integration support, runs through Oct. 7, 2027, and could grow to $12.7 million. The Space Development Age
candidates.full: - The Space Development Agency awarded SpaceX $9.9 million to study using its Plaser laser terminal for missile warning and tracking satellites. - The study includes representative hardware and integration support, runs through Oct. 7, 2027, and could grow to $12.7 million. The Space Development Agency has awarded SpaceX a $9.9 million contract to study whether the company’s commercial “Plaser” laser terminal can be used on the Pentagon’s missile warning and tracking satellites. The deal, announced by the U.S. Department of War on Nov. 10 and awarded on Nov. 9, covers a risk reduction study, delivery of representative hardware, and support for integrating the terminal into missile warning and tracking systems, with options that could raise its value to $12.7 million. SpaceX will do the work at its headquarters in Hawthorne, California, and in Redmond, Washington, where the company runs its Starlink satellite engineering, and is scheduled to finish by Oct. 7, 2027. The full $9.9 million comes from fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds and was obligated at the time of award. The agency bought the study through its Systems, Technologies, and Emerging Capabilities broad agency announcement, an open solicitation that accepts proposals throughout the year, so the number of competing bids is not known. Plaser, short for SpaceX’s “Plug and Plaser” product, is the optical inter-satellite terminal developed for the Starlink constellation and offered to outside satellite operators. SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell announced the commercial offering in March 2024, telling Reuters it was a departure for a company that usually builds its own systems end to end. “We generally don’t sell components, so this is a little bit of a new thing for us,” said SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell. Laser links matter to the Space Development Agency because its Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture relies on hundreds of small satellites in low Earth orbit that pass data to one another by light rather than radio. The agency’s Tracking Layer satellites, which carry infrared sensors to detect and follow ballistic and hypersonic missiles, use optical communication terminals to send their data through the Transport Layer’s mesh network to ground stations and weapon systems. Optical links carry more data than radio links and are harder to detect or jam, but they demand precise pointing between fast-moving satellites. The SDA has set its own optical communication terminal standard and tests vendors’ terminals for interoperability at the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory. As of March 2024, SpaceX had not put its commercial terminals through that testing, while four other suppliers, Tesat-Spacecom, Mynaric, Skyloom and CACI/SA Photonics, had passed, Space Intel Report wrote at the time. The contract announcement does not say whether the new study will test Plaser against the SDA standard, or whether the terminal would fly on Tracking Layer satellites themselves or connect them to another network. SpaceX has publicly released few specifications for Plaser. The company’s smaller Starlink “mini laser,” which satellite builder Muon Space agreed in October 2025 to integrate into its Halo platform, is rated at 25 gigabits per second over distances of up to 4,000 km (2,485 miles), with higher speeds at shorter range. The study is small next to SpaceX’s other recent military space work. In May 2026, the U.S. Space Force awarded the company a $2.29 billion fixed-price agreement to build the backbone of its Space Data Network, a proliferated low Earth orbit constellation meant to carry data from missile warning and tracking sensors to interceptors for the Golden Dome missile defense effort. The service requires a fully operational prototype by the end of 2027, Reuters reported, and said the network would work alongside the SDA’s Transport Layer. SpaceX also launches much of the SDA constellation. The company holds task orders under the U.S. Space Force’s National Security Space Launch program, including the $5.9 billion launch deal the Pentagon awarded in 2025, and has carried several batches of SDA Transport and Tracking Layer satellites into orbit on Falcon 9 rockets. The Tracking Layer itself is growing quickly. In December 2025, the SDA awarded four agreements worth about $3.5 billion for 72 Tranche 3 Tracking Layer satellites, 18 each from Lockheed Martin, Rocket Lab USA, Northrop Grumman and L3Harris Technologies, for launch starting in fiscal 2029. Each of those satellites carries optical communication terminals alongside an infrared payload, Ka-band communications and an S-band backup command link. The announcement does not say which tranche or which tracking satellite design the Plaser study is meant to support. It also does not say what the “representative hardware” will be, or whether the agency plans a follow-on purchase if the study succeeds. Those answers would come after the study ends in October 2027, about 18 months before the first Tranche 3 tracking satellites are due to launch.

candidates.full: China Chipmaker SigmaStar Said to Plan $300 Million HK Listing SigmaStar Technology Ltd. is seeking to raise as much as $300 million in a Hong Kong listing as soon as this year, people familiar with the matter said. The company has begun meeting prospective investors ahead of the potential offering and is working with China International Capital Corp. and China Securities International. SigmaStar designs chips for products including security systems, sports cameras, self-driving vehicles, and smart home devices, according to the company’s website. SigmaStar Technology Ltd., a Chinese artificial intelligence chipmaker, is seeking to raise as much as $300 million in a Hong Kong listing as soon as this year, people familiar with the matter said, as the nation’s technology companies look for an opportune fundraising window. The Xiamen-based company has begun meeting prospective investors ahead of the potential offering, the people said, asking not to be identified as the information isn’t public. SigmaStar is working with China International Capital Corp. and China Securities International, according to a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange. A representative for SigmaStar didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. SigmaStar, whose shares have gained 67% this year in Shenzhen, would add at a recent resurgence of fundraising in Hong Kong by Chinese technology companies. Issuers, including those in the artificial intelligence supply chain, have braved bouts of volatility as doubts mounted over the technology. That helped share sales regain momentum in the city, where listings had slowed after a blockbuster pace through the summer. Hong Kong debuts have raised $52.2 billion this year, approaching the 2010 record of $57.8 billion, according to data compiled by Bloomberg, Chinese semiconductor makers and other AI supply-chain firms have driven the fundraising, buoyed by Beijing’s drive to foster national champions and boost the country’s self-reliance efforts. Major deals include Shanghai Biren Technology Co., whose shares surged more than 70% in their January debut, and Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co., which raised $903 million in an upsized share sale. Read More: HK Listing Proceeds Hit Six-Year High, Inch Closer to Record Founded in 2017, SigmaStar designs chips for security systems, sports cameras, self-driving vehicles, and smart home devices, among other products, according to the company’s website. Taiwan’s MediaTek Inc. previously held 16.5% stake in the company through its subsidiary, which disposed of the shareholding in 2021.

candidates.summary: Rusya-Çin askeri yakınlaşması ABD'nin güvenlik hesaplarını etkiliyor Google algoritmasına bırakmayın, okuyacağınız haberi siz seçin! Tıkla ve ekle AA Analiz yazısında Doç. candidates.full: Rusya-Çin askeri yakınlaşması ABD'nin güvenlik hesaplarını etkiliyor Google algoritmasına bırakmayın, okuyacağınız haberi siz seçin! Tıkla ve ekle AA Analiz yazısında Doç. Dr. Merve Suna Özel Özcan, 3 Kasım'da Pekin'deki Rusya-Çin savunma görüşmesinin yeni eşik arayışı olduğunu değerlendirdi. Özcan'a göre derinleşen askeri eş güdüm, ABD'nin güvenlik hesaplarını etkileyerek küresel güç dağılımının dönüşümünü hızlandırabilir. Kırıkkale Üniversitesi Uluslararası İlişkiler Bölümü Öğretim Üyesi Doç. Dr. Merve Suna Özel Özcan, Rusya ve Çin arasındaki askeri yakınlaşmanın küresel güç dengelerine ve ABD'nin güvenlik stratejilerine etkisini AA Analiz için kaleme aldı. *** Rusya ve Çin'in bugünkü askeri kapasiteleri, uluslararası sistemdeki güç mücadelesinin iki farklı yüzünü ortaya koyuyor. Rusya, Sovyetler Birliği'nden devraldığı stratejik nükleer kapasite, füze sistemleri, enerji kaynakları ve Ukrayna Savaşı'nda edindiği askeri tecrübesiyle küresel güvenlik mimarisini doğrudan etkilerken, Çin ise genişleyen ekonomik ve teknolojik kapasitesini modern bir askeri güce dönüştürerek özellikle Hint-Pasifik merkezli stratejik dengeleri değiştiriyor. Bu nedenle iki ülkeyi yalnızca asker sayıları veya silah envanterleri üzerinden değerlendirmek eksik kalacaktır. Asıl mesele, askeri gücün ekonomik sürdürülebilirliği, teknolojik özerklik, harekat kabiliyeti, nükleer caydırıcılık ve uluslararası sistemde siyasi etki oluşturma kapasitesiyle ne ölçüde bütünleştiğidir. Tam bu noktada 3 Kasım'da Pekin'de Rusya Savunma Bakanı Andrey Belousov ile Çin Merkez Askeri Komisyonu Başkan Yardımcısı Zhang Shengmin arasında gerçekleştirilen görüşme, iki ülke ilişkilerinin askeri boyutunda yeni bir eşik arayışını ortaya koyuyor. [1] Görüşmede stratejik istişarelerin, ortak eğitimlerin ve bilimsel-teknolojik işbirliğinin güçlendirilmesi yönündeki irade, münferit bir diplomatik temasın ötesinde değerlendirilmelidir. Zira Rusya ile Çin arasındaki yakınlaşma, yalnızca ikili savunma ilişkilerinin derinleşmesi değil, uluslararası sistemde güç dağılımının ve güvenlik mimarisinin yeniden şekillenmesine yönelik daha geniş bir arayışın da parçasıdır. Bu yönüyle mesele, bir askeri ittifakın kurulup kurulmadığı sorusundan daha kapsamlıdır: İki devlet, ayrı coğrafyalarda sürdürdükleri rekabeti birbirlerinin lehine ne ölçüde dönüştürebilecektir? Stratejik kapasite Rusya ve Çin arasındaki ilişkiyi açıklamak için askeri kapasite, ekonomik güç ve stratejik bağımlılık birlikte ele alınmalıdır. Soğuk Savaş döneminde Sovyetler Birliği ile Çin arasındaki ideolojik yakınlaşma, 1960'lardan itibaren derinleşen stratejik rekabete dönüşmüş, Sovyetler Birliği'nin dağılmasının ardından ise ilişkiler yeni bir zeminde yeniden şekillenmiştir. 2001'de imzalanan İyi Komşuluk, Dostluk ve İşbirliği Antlaşması, 2014 sonrasında genişleyen ekonomik ve siyasi ilişkiler ile 2022'de ilan edilen "sınırsız ortaklık" söylemi, bugünkü askeri yakınlaşmanın tarihsel ve siyasi zeminini oluşturmuştur. İki ülkenin askeri kapasitelerindeki dönüşüm ve bu kapasitelerin sürdürülebilirliği de değerlendirilmelidir. Rusya'nın savunma yönetiminde Mayıs 2024'te yaşanan değişim önemlidir. Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin'in, uzun yıllar Savunma Bakanlığı görevini yürüten Sergey Şoygu'nun yerine ekonomist Andrey Belousov'u getirmesi, Moskova'nın güvenlik anlayışında ekonomik ve endüstriyel kapasitenin belirleyici hale geldiğini ortaya koydu. Zira Belousov, cephedeki askeri komutayı değiştirmekten ziyade savunma harcamalarının etkinliğini artırmayı, savunma sanayisi ile devletin ekonomik kurumları arasındaki eş güdümü güçlendirmeyi ve uzun süreli savaşın gerektirdiği üretim kapasitesini tahkim etmeyi amaçlamıştır. Ayrıca Moskova açısından bu yakınlaşma, Ukrayna savaşı sonrasında daralan ekonomik ve teknolojik hareket alanını genişletirken, Pasifik'teki stratejik varlığını tahkim etme imkanı da sunmaktadır. Pekin bakımından ise Rusya ile geliştirilen askeri eş güdüm, kuzey sınırında istikrarın korunması ve ABD'nin Hint-Pasifik'teki askeri ağırlığının dengelenmesi açısından önem taşımaktadır. Dolayısıyla Pekin'deki görüşmeler, yalnızca iki ülkenin ortak tatbikatlarını artırma iradesi üzerinden değil, askeri üretim ile teknolojik kapasite arasında gelişen stratejik tamamlayıcılık üzerinden de okunmalıdır. Çünkü askeri işbirliği derinleşirken, ekonomik asimetrinin de belirginleşmesi, iki ülke arasındaki gelecekteki ilişkilerde üzerinde durulması gereken temel meselelerden biridir. Savunmada stratejik ortaklığın sınırları Stockholm merkezli Uluslararası Barış Araştırmaları Enstitüsünün (SIPRI) verilerine göre, 2021-2025 döneminde Rusya'nın küresel büyük silah ihracatındaki payı yüzde 6,8'e gerilerken, Çin'in payı yüzde 5,6 düzeyinde gerçekleşmiştir. Önceki 5 yıllık dönemle karşılaştırıldığında Rusya'nın ihracat hacmi yüzde 64 azalırken, Çin'in ihracatı yüzde 11 artmış, silah ithalatı ise yüzde 72 gerilemiştir. Rusya'nın silah ihracatındaki gerilemede Ukrayna savaşının savunma sanayisine yönelik iç talebi artırması, yaptırımlar ve geleneksel ihracat pazarlarındaki daralma etkili olmuştur. Nitekim SIPRI Top 100 verilerinde 2024 yılında 8 Çinli savunma şirketinin toplam silah geliri 88,3 milyar dolar olurken, verileri sağlanabilen 2 Rus şirketinin geliri 31,2 milyar dolar olarak kalmıştır. Çinli şirketlerin gelirleri yüzde 10 azalırken, Rus şirketlerinin gelirlerinde yüzde 23 artış kaydedilmiştir. Bununla birlikte Rusya'ya ilişkin verilerin sınırlı olması, toplam üretim kapasitesinin doğrudan karşılaştırılmasını güçleştirmektedir. Asıl dikkat çekici husus, silah ihracatının yöneldiği ülkelerdir. Aynı dönemde Rusya'nın ihracatının yüzde 48'i Hindistan'a, Çin'in ihracatının ise yüzde 61'i Pakistan'a gerçekleşmiştir. [2] Dolayısıyla Moskova ile Pekin arasındaki askeri yakınlaşma, Asya'daki tüm stratejik çıkarların örtüştüğü anlamına gelmemektedir. Keza ABD'nin Hint-Pasifik'teki askeri varlığı ve Hindistan başta olmak üzere diğer bölgesel aktörlerin güvenlik öncelikleri dikkate alındığında, Asya'daki askeri dengenin yalnızca Moskova ve Pekin tarafından belirlendiğini söylemek zordur. Ancak bugün Asya'nın askeri ve stratejik dengeleri Rusya ile Çin'in kapasitesi ve aralarındaki eş güdüm hesaba katılmadan da değerlendirilemez. Tatbikatların ötesi ve kesişen hedefler Temmuz 2026'da Çin'in Çingdao kentinde gerçekleştirilen Joint Sea-2026 tatbikatında ortak komuta kabiliyetinin yanı sıra keşif, hava ve füze savunması, denizaltı arama-kurtarma ve müşterek harekat kabiliyetleri önemliydi. Haziranda Japon Denizi, Doğu Çin Denizi ve Batı Pasifik üzerinde gerçekleştirilen 11. ortak stratejik hava devriyesi ise iki ülkenin askeri eş güdümünü kendi sınırlarının ötesine taşıdığını gösterdi. Ancak asıl dikkati çekmek istediğim husus, askeri işbirliğinin giderek başka devletlerin katılımıyla daha geniş bir coğrafyaya yayılması. Çünkü Eylül 2026'da Çin, Rusya ve Moğolistan'ın gerçekleştirdiği Border Defense Cooperation-2026 tatbikatı, ortak sınır güvenliği ve insansız sistemlerin kullanımı bakımından önem taşırken, Ocak 2026'da Güney Afrika açıklarında düzenlenen Will for Peace-2026 deniz tatbikatına İran ve Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nin (BAE) de katılması, bu askeri temasların Asya'nın ötesine uzandığını gösterdi. Şanghay İşbirliği Örgütü (ŞİÖ) bünyesinde Kazakistan, Kırgızistan, Tacikistan, Özbekistan, Hindistan, Pakistan ve İran gibi ülkelerin yer aldığı güvenlik ve terörle mücadele faaliyetleri, Moskova ile Pekin'in çok taraflı güvenlik ilişkilerinin geliştiği alanlardır. Rusya ve Çin, derinleşen askeri işbirlikleriyle Asya'nın güvenlik mimarisinde artan ağırlıklarını kıtanın ötesine taşıyarak küresel güç dengelerini etkiliyor. Bugün Moskova-Pekin yakınlaşmasının esas önemi, sadece iki ülkenin askeri güçlerini artırmalarında değil, Asya'dan Afrika'ya uzanan stratejik ilişkileriyle ABD'nin farklı coğrafyalardaki güvenlik hesaplarını eş zamanlı olarak etkileyebilecek bir kapasite oluşturmalarında aranmalıdır. Önümüzdeki dönemde Rusya ile Çin'in derinleşen askeri eş güdümünün, yalnızca Asya'nın güvenlik mimarisini yeniden şekillendirmekle kalmayıp farklı coğrafyalarda ABD'nin stratejik hareket alanını daraltarak küresel güç dağılımının dönüşümünü hızlandıracağı beklenebilir. candidates.title: Ник Кейв назвал генераторы песен ИИ «душеразрушающим унижением»
candidates.summary: Ник Кейв поделился мнением об ИИ в музыке, назвав платформы‑генераторы песен «знаками демонического потенциала этой новой технологии, способной обесценить человеческий труд и разорвать нашу связь с божественным». candidates.full: Ник Кейв поделился мнением об ИИ в музыке, назвав платформы‑генераторы песен «знаками демонического потенциала этой новой технологии, способной обесценить человеческий труд и разорвать нашу связь с божественным». Легендарный музыкант Ник Кейв поделился своими мыслями об использовании ИИ, сказав, что не уверен, «спасет ли эта спорная технология мир» или «уничтожит его». В последнем выпуске своего информационного бюллетеня The Red Hand Files (источник на английском языке) Кейв ответил на вопрос фаната о том, является ли он «думером или бумером» по отношению к ИИ. «Искусственный интеллект, ответил он, может спасти мир, уничтожить его или сделать что-то между этим. Я не знаю». Продолжая тему растущей роли ИИ в создании новой музыки, Кейв написал: «Платформы для генерации песен, на мой взгляд, являются указателями демонического потенциала этой зарождающейся технологии опустошать человеческие усилия и разрывать нашу связь с божественным». «Они высмеивают само творение, делая человечество ненужным, забирают плоды человеческих усилий и сводят их к простым продуктам. Это, возможно, наше последнее, наиболее разрушающее душу унижение», объяснил он. Музыкант уже давно является громким критиком искусственного интеллекта, в прошлом называя его «невероятно тревожным» и ранее говоря ChatGPT: «пошел к черту и оставь написание песен в покое». Он также рассказывал, что получал многочисленные заявки с текстами песен, сгенерированными ИИ «в стиле Ника Кейва», которые он назвал «гротескным издевательством над тем, что значит быть человеком». В прошлом году он, по-видимому, смягчил свою позицию. Отвечая на вопрос фаната о том, является ли смена мнения признаком слабости, в контексте фильма режиссера Andrew Donminik 'Tupelo' (в котором используется ИИ), Кейв признал, что изменение когда-то жестких убеждений может быть признаком силы. «Когда я смотрел сюрреалистичный маленький фильм Эндрю, я почувствовал, что мой взгляд на ИИ как на художественный инструмент смягчился. В какой-то степени мое мнение изменилось», написал Кейв об видео с ИИ, созданном к 40-летнему юбилею его песни 'Tupelo'. Он признал, что кадры выглядели «зловеще», поскольку в ролике ИИ анимировал неподвижные архивные изображения Элвиса Пресли. Тогда Кейв говорил, что анимированные с помощью ИИ фотографии Пресли «обладали зловещим качеством, словно его воскресили из мертвых, а изображения распятия и воскресения в финале были одновременно шокирующими и глубоко трогательными». Теперь, похоже, Кейв вновь перешел к осуждению генеративного ИИ во всех его проявлениях, особенно когда речь идет о написании песен. Когда другой поклонник спросил его, можно ли отделить произведение искусства от художника, в рамках многолетней дискуссии, преследующей артистов и любителей культуры, Кейв ответил: «Мы не можем отделить искусство от художников, поскольку они так же неразделимы, как волны и море, из которого они поднимаются. Это может быть неприятной истиной для некоторых, но для меня вопрос был закрыт. До сих пор». Он продолжил: «С появлением платформ для генерации песен этот болезненный вопрос был перевернут. Наконец-то художника можно отделить от искусства. Мало того, художника, этого несовершенного, запутанного, сломанного, жалкого, радостного источника проблем, можно вообще убрать из уравнения, как ненужный мусор». Обращая критику к песенному генератору ИИ Suno, он продолжил: «Suno, Великий отменитель, который никогда не любил, не смеялся и не горевал, никогда не испытывал радости, потерь или разбитого сердца, никогда не чувствовал скуки и последующего озарения, создает имитацию души, песню, за пятнадцать секунд. Это оскорбление для любого автора песен, который жил и боролся в этом мире и заслужил право создавать песню». Он завершил: «Для тех, кто стремится избавить мир от проблемных художников, а эти цензурирующие силы по-прежнему настойчивы, это, несомненно, повод для празднования, поскольку такие платформы обещают избавить мир от художников вообще». Последний на сегодняшний день альбом Nick Cave And The Bad Seeds, вышедший в 2024 году, называется 'Wild God' и вошел в итоговый список лучших альбомов 2024 года по версии Euronews Culture. Недавно Кейв объявил североамериканский тур 2027 года, в рамках которого он будет отвечать на вопросы поклонников и исполнять на пианино «обнаженные» версии своих песен. Билеты на новый тур 'Conversations With Nick Cave: An Evening Of Talk And Music' поступят в продажу в пятницу (13 ноября).

candidates.title: Jane Street – Our software engineering interviews are changing (a little)
candidates.summary: Over the last few years, LLMs have changed how software gets built and that’s no different for us at Jane Street. Most of our engineers now use them every day not only for writing code, but also for reading, debugging, and reviewing code, and plenty of things that aren’t code at all. We’ve talked ab
candidates.full: Over the last few years, LLMs have changed how software gets built and that’s no different for us at Jane Street. Most of our engineers now use them every day not only for writing code, but also for reading, debugging, and reviewing code, and plenty of things that aren’t code at all. We’ve talked about this recently in a podcast on how we use AI in our development, and in a post on formal methods that touches on how agentic coding is reshaping the way we work. Our coding interviews haven’t changed, though. The questions we ask software engineers today are the same style of question we’ve been asking for years: sit down with an interviewer or two, program through a problem together, and talk as you go. That style has served us well and the key goals remain the same: we want to see how you solve problems, structure your work, communicate, and collaborate in the pursuit of excellent software development. But the shape of the job has evolved, and we think our interviews should evolve, too. As generating code has become arguably cheaper than ever, other parts of the job have come to matter even more: taste about what to build, choosing abstractions that last, and making sure what got built is actually correct, among other things. So this summer we started trialing some new kinds of interviews in our onsites for campus candidates. Broadly, they involve less code-writing, and lean more higher-level, focusing on software design, on verifying the quality, structure, and intention of code, and on using LLMs to produce code. Most rounds will continue to be traditional coding interviews, conducted without LLM assistance. We know this sounds vague, but that’s intentional: the formats are still evolving, and we’d rather not describe something in detail today that looks different in six months. A few things worth knowing: - Not every onsite includes these new rounds yet, and when you come on-site we’ll give you a heads-up about what to expect. - The rest of our process is unchanged. If you’ve read our earlier posts about interviewing here, they’re still accurate. - While we find LLMs incredibly valuable as part of our daily work, we also recognize that not everyone has deep experience working with them. You shouldn’t feel like you need to have a highly worked out methodology for working with agents in order to do well in our process. In the end, we’re looking for people with great instincts for building software, and we don’t feel like we need an LLM to evaluate that. - Different folks have integrated LLMs into their workflows in different ways and to different degrees, and we don’t expect you to have a particular setup or to use them for everything. What we care about is that you think clearly about the tools you use: what they’re good at, where they fall short, and when to reach for something else. - As has been the case for some time, our more experienced candidates’ interviews will continue to be more varied, featuring a range of interview styles, from producing software to designing systems and discussing prior work. As always, we’ll keep iterating, and we’ll write more when there’s more to say. If you’re interested in working with us, apply on our website!

Starshield drives af den amerikanske rumvirksomhed SpaceX, som ledes af Elon Musk. Satellitsystemet er vigtigt for Ukraines luftforsvar. - Det ukrainske militær har allerede efterforsket omstændighederne, og dette er ikke tilfældige fejl, men systematiske hastighedsbegrænsninger, skriver Zelenskyj. Også i oktober blev systemet ramt af hastighedsbegrænsninger. Her sagde Elon Musk, at begrænsningerne måtte være foranlediget af USA's militær og i sidste ende USA's præsident, Donald Trump. candidates.title: Физики ищут защиту от путешествий во времени: у новой модели нашли слабое место
candidates.summary: Физики предложили новый математический подход, который может помочь решить один из самых известных парадоксов путешествий во времени - так называемый парадокс дедушки. Разработанная модель описывает гравитацию так, чтобы сделать невозможным движение времени назад. Об этом сообщает РБК-Украина со ссы
candidates.full: Физики предложили новый математический подход, который может помочь решить один из самых известных парадоксов путешествий во времени - так называемый парадокс дедушки. Разработанная модель описывает гравитацию так, чтобы сделать невозможным движение времени назад. Об этом сообщает РБК-Украина со ссылкой на исследование, опубликованное в журнале Physical Review D. Защита хронологии по гипотезе Стивена Гокинга Путешествия во времени рождают не только фантастические сюжеты, но и серьезные научные противоречия. Один из самых известных примеров - парадокс дедушки: как изменится история, если путешественник во времени убьет собственного дедушку до рождения своего отца? В таком случае он сам не должен появиться на свет, а значит, не смог бы совершить это путешествие. В 1992 году физик Стивен Хокинг предложил гипотезу защиты хронологии. Она предусматривает, что законы физики не допускают появления замкнутых временных кривых - траекторий, позволяющих вернуться в прошлое. Однако общая теория относительности Эйнштейна математически не исключает существования таких путей, а ученые до сих пор не имеют четкого объяснения, что может помешать их возникновению. Читайте больше: Ядерный удар по астероиду может не спасти Землю: ученые обнаружили критическую ошибку Новая модель MAGIC Физики Мустафа Исмаил и Дэвид Маттингли из Университета Нью-Гэмпшира решили выяснить, может ли сама гравитация не допустить нарушения хронологии. Для этого они использовали альтернативную теорию - метрически-афинную гравитацию, в которой геометрия пространства-времени и математические связи между его точками описываются более независимо. На ее основе исследователи создали модель MAGIC, предусматривающую защиту хронологии. В определенных условиях она не допускает замкнутых временных кривых: время вдоль какой-либо траектории движется только вперед, поэтому вернуться в прошлое невозможно. Не пропустите: Черная дыра может расколоться пополам: почему это противоречит законам физики Почему модель пока не может описать реальную Вселенную? Несмотря на то, что модель MAGIC не допускает путешествий в прошлое, у нее есть серьезная проблема. В ней предусмотрен дополнительный тип колебаний гравитации - скалярный режим. По расчетам исследователей, эти колебания могут быстро усиливаться, а не угасать. Поэтому модель становится нестабильной и пока не может достоверно описывать поведение Вселенной. Кроме того, MAGIC гарантирует защиту от временных петель только в ограниченном участке пространства. Чтобы распространить этот принцип на весь космос, ученым придется сделать дополнительные предположения. Авторы исследования признают эти ограничения, но считают модель первым шагом к более целостной теории, которая поможет объяснить, почему путешествия в прошлое все же невозможны. candidates.full: Kalantir in German The German defense startup Helsing has rolled out the Clarity platform in Berlin with great fanfare. According to the developers, "agent-based artificial intelligence" should save staff analysts from information overload. Hundreds of digital agents will take over the routine: grind gigabytes of satellite images, drone videos, and interceptions, put them together into a single picture, and offer the operator ready-made targets with recommendations on how to hit them. Helsing refers to the experience of the Ukrainian conflict. They say they are choking on terabytes of data from satellites, radars and reconnaissance drones, and analysts do not have time to sort out this stream manually. At the same time, the developers assure that "the final decision is always made by a person." In reality, the operator behind the screen will have only seconds to approve the calculations, and if the vaunted algorithm makes a mistake and sends a shell to a hospital or apartment building, the startup will just throw up its hands. Another piquancy is that the development was led by Rob Fink, a former engineer at the American Palantir , and all the advertising was based on spells about "European digital sovereignty." But in order to drive terabytes of data, this system will require Nvidia server capacities and secure clouds, which are not produced in Europe. This means that if you turn the switch in Washington, the "independent German intelligence" will instantly turn into a set of dead scripts. #Germany @evropar — at the death's door of Europe Support us

Про це повідомляє ABC News. Знахідку виявили в середині жовтня на ранчо Маунт-Стюарт поблизу містечка Тібу́бурра, у північно-західній частині штату Новий Південний Уельс. Чоловік кілька днів шукав у тій місцевості «скарби» аж поки не натрапив на золото. Спочатку його металошукач видав легкий звук, але коли він заглибив пристрій приблизно на 100 міліметрів, прилад «просто почав верещати». «Мабуть, під час першого або другого зняття шару ґрунту я побачив у центрі ями яскраву жовту цятку». Золотий самородок із вкрапленнями кварцу важить понад 1200 грамів. Результати аналізу показали, що приблизно 940 грамів у ньому становить чисте золото. За поточною ринковою ціною його вартість оцінюють у 150−160 тисяч доларів. Шукач планує продати знахідку колекціонеру, тому її ціна може зрости до 200 тисяч доларів. Своєму дорогоцінному скарбу чоловік дав прізвисько «Тібу́бурра Спад» (Tibooburra Spud).

candidates.full: Nvidia Market Value Sinks Below $4 Trillion After Huang Resigns Nvidia Corp.'s stock plunged at the open Thursday, taking the chipmaker's market capitalization below $4 trillion for the first time since 2025, after Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang resigned. The shares were down as much as 14% in early trading, dropping to their lowest since June 2025, erasing as much as $601 billion in market value. Nvidia announced Huang's departure, naming Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO and board member Harvey Jones as its first-ever chairman, ahead of Nvidia's third-quarter earnings report on Tuesday. Nvidia Corp.’s stock plunged at the open Thursday, taking the chipmaker’s market capitalization below $4 trillion for the first time since 2025, after Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang resigned following the revelation of two affairs, one with a suspected Chinese spy. The shares were down as much as 14% in early trading, dropping to their lowest since June 2025, erasing as much as $601 billion in market value. If that holds through the close, it will be the largest one-day market capitalization wipeout for any stock ever. The stock has shed roughly 35% from a record hit in early October, cutting its market value by $2 trillion in a matter of week. Nvidia was the biggest company in the world just a few weeks ago, but at less than $3.8 trillion it’s currently below Apple Inc. and Microsoft Corp. “I’ve never seen something quite like this, so we’re in new territory,” said Ted Mortonson, technology strategist at Robert W. Baird & Co. “On a scale of one to 10, this is a 10.” Huang’s ability to stay at the helm of the most important artificial intelligence chipmaker has been under scrutiny since Sunday, when he admitted to a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at the Singaporean data center firm Megaspeed International who’s suspected of spying for China. Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported that Huang also had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, citing unidentified people who worked at the company. Nvidia announced Huang’s departure before the market opened Thursday, naming Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO and board member Harvey Jones as its first-ever chairman. The news comes ahead of Nvidia’s third-quarter earnings report on Tuesday. The company expected to show strong growth amid robust demand for AI chips, but the scandals are causing investors and analysts to flee the stock, with at least seven Wall Street firms downgrading Nvidia over the past week. Meanwhile, the cost of protecting the firm’s debt against default neared a record. The questions surrounding Huang added to growing concerns about the strength and longevity of the AI trade overall. Quarterly results from major Nvidia customers like Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com Inc. and Meta Platforms Inc. underscored how investors are losing patience with big spending on AI, especially as it turns cash flows negative. At the same time, the US midterm elections showed many voters oppose building data centers anywhere near their communities, further clouding the outlook for spending, which translates to revenue at chipmakers and other companies involved in AI infrastructure. Read More: Jensen Huang’s 700,000% Return Magnifies Nvidia Succession Risks (1) Nvidia is down 15% in 2026, on track for its worst year since 2022. In contrast, the Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index is up 47% this year.

candidates.summary: MBAs vs. DSA The next Congress will include eight members backed by the Democratic Socialists of America or its local chapters, and outsize media attention has been focused on this DSA contingent. But what about Team MBA? At least 19 House Democrats who won last week, including incumbents, have a m
candidates.full: MBAs vs. DSA The next Congress will include eight members backed by the Democratic Socialists of America or its local chapters, and outsize media attention has been focused on this DSA contingent. But what about Team MBA? At least 19 House Democrats who won last week, including incumbents, have a master’s degree in business administration. The diploma isn’t an ideological credential, but it’s a promising indicator that at least some on the blue side of the aisle understand how firms raise capital, manage risk, price products, allocate resources and compete. An MBA offers an antidote to the DSA fantasy that prosperity can be legislated, or taxed, into existence. The DSA mostly made blue seats bluer while newly elected MBAs defeated GOP incumbents in battlegrounds. Rep.-elect Rebecca Bennett (D-New Jersey) earned her master’s degree at the Wharton School and became an executive at a digital health start-up after flying helicopters in the Navy. Rep.-elect Paige Cognetti (D-Pennsylvania), a Harvard Business School graduate, worked briefly at Goldman Sachs before becoming mayor of Scranton. Cait Conley received her MBA at MIT after 16 years in the Army and went into the Biden administration. Before challenging Rep. Mike Lawler (R-New York), she consulted for an enterprise software company and a firm that makes anti-drone technology. The Senate offers another good example. Political junkies know Sen.-elect Josh Turek (D-Iowa) as a Paralympic gold medalist. He also earned an MBA from the Keller Graduate School of Management, part of DeVry University, and worked for Numotion, a provider of customized wheelchairs. This new crop is partly the result of recruitment efforts. Rep. Suzan DelBene (D-Washington), who chairs the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee, earned her MBA at the University of Washington. She spent 12 years at Microsoft, helped launch drugstore.com and served as CEO of a software company before winning a House seat in 2012. In the current Congress, 18 Democrats and 26 Republicans hold MBAs, according to the clerk. But 11 of the 26 Republicans will not return next year, and the number of incoming GOP members with the degree isn’t clear. Possessing an MBA does not automatically translate into having economic common sense, of course, and too many business executives have a misplaced faith in central planning or develop a dependency on government subsidies. But the essential insight needed for any Democrat trying to deliver on promises to make life more affordable is that economic growth is not a zero-sum contest between workers and businesses. When companies do well, so do their employees and the communities where they operate. MBAs are far more likely to understand this intuitively than left-wing ideologues marinated in the us-versus-them politics of grievance and redistribution. The DSA is explicit about its ambitions to nationalize large corporations and industries such as energy and transit. Republicans have eroded confidence in capitalism by straying from historic principles of free markets and limited government. Too many on the right have embraced tariffs and state ownership of private enterprises. It’s unclear how many MBAs will remain next year in the House GOP Conference. But network exit polls last week showed that 56 percent of voters nationally viewed capitalism favorably, compared with 33 percent for socialism. The New Democrat Coalition, which identifies as pro-growth, pro-innovation and fiscally responsible, counts 114 members in the current Congress. Its ranks next year are projected to expand to 142. These folks can serve as a counterweight to the roughly 105 members of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, though there is some overlap between the groups. If Democrats want to preserve their majority, they would do well to focus on making markets work rather than trying to usurp them. candidates.title: Launch HN: Pomerado (YC F26) – Turn any website into an MCP for agents
candidates.summary: | | Hacker Newsnew \| past \| comments \| ask \| show \| jobs \| submit | login | | | | Launch HN: Pomerado (YC F26) – Turn any website into an MCP for agents | | | | 38 points by alanjm23 4 hours ago \| hide \| past \| favorite \| 32 comments | | | | Hi HN, we’re Alan and Akshay from Pome
candidates.full: | | Hacker Newsnew \| past \| comments \| ask \| show \| jobs \| submit | login | | | | Launch HN: Pomerado (YC F26) – Turn any website into an MCP for agents | | | | 38 points by alanjm23 4 hours ago \| hide \| past \| favorite \| 32 comments | | | | Hi HN, we’re Alan and Akshay from Pomerado (https://pomerado.ai/). We connect your agents to any website by turning sites into deterministic, self-healing APIs in minutes, fully self-serve. Agents are no longer limited by their intelligence, but rather by their ability to interact with systems. Airlines, banks, e-commerce, insurance portals, government sites, and legacy portals all lack APIs or MCPs and are common parts of personal assistant or business workflows. Agents instead rely on browser automation or computer use, which can be slow, expensive, and unreliable. And even if computer use were perfect, most companies have banned it out of security and compliance concerns. We discovered this problem while tinkering with our own personal assistants. When OpenClaw came out, we wanted to “live our lives through our agents” and have them do everything for us. We soon found their usefulness was restricted by what tools they could connect to. For example, when trying to book flights, they fell back on computer use, which failed to checkout. These issues got magnified on repeated workflows, like searching many airlines at once. Pomerado started off as a project to improve these personal assistant workflows. As we started building, we realized that just-in-time tool creation could have significant applications for AI builders in legacy verticals. We’re ex-McKinsey and Scale AI, where we drove agent deployments in healthcare, professional services, and telecom. Each time, the biggest bottleneck was getting agents to interface well with legacy websites and apps. Pomerado is what we built. It’s a self-serve platform where devs can create APIs for any website (even those they don’t own), in minutes. Users (or their coding agents) provide a short natural language description, answer a few questions about their workflow, and receive a MCP in less than an hour. Future tool calls use the deterministic MCP, which usually returns results in 5-30 seconds. Here’s a walkthrough of our product: https://youtu.be/Bi4jci7rgHo In practice: - Our agent opens a browser, explores the website, and performs the requested task once by writing HTTP requests or a Playwright script. This example run establishes how to navigate the website, interact with the relevant controls, and obtain the desired result. If any additional user input is needed (e.g., login, clarification) the agent will ask the user over MCP. - Afterwards, the agent uses the example run, along with all of the data it recorded, to create a generalizable and repeatable API. Throughout this process, a separate Guardian model reviews the coding agent’s calls against a set of guardrails. We also run a battery of tests with synthetic inputs to ensure that the API is generalized and not overfit to one input. A final publication agent ensures that the integration publishes a reasonable and generalized input/output schema - We also handle sites that require authentication and 2FA. For authentication, we pass off to a deterministic sign-in process to ensure the model and our recorders never read customer credentials. Users can store 2FA TOTP seeds or link their account to a Pomerado phone number for us to autofill 2FA for them as well - If future runs fail, a maintenance job is kicked off to repair and improve the tool. The maintenance job can fix broken steps (e.g., a renamed button), add additional functionality (e.g., searching for business class flights in addition to economy), or add new guardrails (e.g., reservation dates must be in the future). We’ve even seen people improve tools by just saying “please make this faster” Unlike computer use, our MCPs are deterministic at runtime, which makes them much faster and cheaper. By taking slightly longer to do a task the first time, you reap the benefits much more in the future. It’s a great fit for repeated, high-volume tasks you want your agent to do. We’d love to have you try it! We have both an open-source (MIT) (https://github.com/Pomerado/pomerado) and a free hosted version (https://app.pomerado.ai). So far, users of Pomerado include: - A personal trainer using agents to prepare workouts and message clients. Before Pomerado, agents couldn’t login and use the site reliably, so this was all manual - Car dealerships connecting their Grok Bots to legacy dealer systems, including marketplaces, CRMs, and ERPs. Dealers switched from computer use, which could take 1hr+ - Personal assistants using Pomerado to integrate with a broad range of consumer websites Please ask any questions or share any feedback in the comments, thanks! |

The Woman Taking Charge Of Nvidia After Jensen Huang's Exit Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since September 2013, when she joined the company. - Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid Chinese spy allegations. - CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO, company seeks successor. - Kress, a veteran finance executive, vowed to continue company's trajectory. - Kress priorities include AI, accelerated computing, and customer delivery. Nvidia is facing a major leadership transition following the resignation of its co-founder and long-serving CEO, Jensen Huang. As reports surrounding Huang's alleged links to a Chinese spy intensified, the controversy drew increased attention to the company. Nvidia had earlier expressed confidence in its chief executive, but Huang has now stepped down from his position. Following the announcement, Nvidia confirmed that its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Colette Kress, would take over as interim CEO. The company has also indicated that it will look for a permanent successor. Here's what to know about Kress, who will temporarily lead the AI giant. Who Is Colette Kress? Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since September 2013, when she joined the company. Before moving to Nvidia, she spent nearly 25 years in senior finance roles at several major technology companies. Kress previously served as Senior Vice President and CFO at Cisco for nearly three years, overseeing various businesses, engineering and financial operations. Before that, she spent nearly 13 years at Microsoft, including four years as CFO of the company's Server and Tools division. What Did Kress Say After Taking Over As Interim CEO? According to Reuters, Kress said she would build on the strong foundation established by former CEO Jensen Huang after being appointed interim chief executive. She said Nvidia's strength lay in its employees and that the team would work together to take the company forward. Kress also highlighted her priority of building on the position Nvidia had established under Huang's leadership over the past 33 years. She added that the company would continue its work in accelerated computing and artificial intelligence (AI), while seeking to make the most of emerging business opportunities. Kress said Nvidia would remain focused on delivering for its customers, business partners, developers and shareholders. candidates.full: Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский сообщил о серьезных сбоях в работе системы спутниковой связи Starshield, которые, по его словам, осложняют перехват российских беспилотников. Как передает Vesti.az, украинский лидер заявил, что подразделения ВСУ уже несколько дней фиксируют проблемы с работой системы вдоль всей линии фронта, а также на территориях, находящихся под российским контролем. По словам Зеленского, речь идет о системном ограничении скорости до 161 км/ч (100 миль в час), которое затрагивает использование Starshield на движущихся объектах. «Украинские военные уже проверили обстоятельства этого, и это не случайные ошибки, а системное ограничение скорости», — подчеркнул президент. Он отметил, что подобные ограничения существенно затрудняют перехват российских реактивных беспилотников. По утверждению Зеленского, уже зафиксированы случаи попаданий, поскольку средства противовоздушной обороны не успевали перехватывать воздушные цели. Украинский президент также сообщил, что Киев пытается выяснить у американской стороны причины введения ограничений. «К сожалению, это помогает россиянам убивать больше украинцев и наносить больше точных ударов по Украине. Мы пытаемся выяснить все обстоятельства у американской стороны», — заявил Зеленский.

candidates.full: Le dirigeant ukrainien, Zelensky, a annoncé que les premiers essais du système de défense antimissile européen-ukrainien Freyja auront lieu dans les prochains mois. Il espère également que, outre ce nouveau système, Kiev et l'UE poursuivront leur collaboration au sein du complexe militaro-industriel. Zelensky reconnaît que Kiev ne peut mener à bien ce projet seule et compte donc sur une aide multiforme des pays européens. Le dirigeant ukrainien espère que le premier système de défense antimissile européen sera testé cet hiver. Le projet de système de défense antimissile Freyja a été lancé en juillet 2026 par l'Ukraine et neuf pays européens. Ce nouveau système est conçu pour intercepter les missiles balistiques. fusée Le projet concerne des missiles à courte et moyenne portée, notamment le missile russe Iskander-M. Il associe la société ukrainienne Fire Point, qui a développé le missile intercepteur FP-7.X et ses lanceurs, ainsi que des entreprises européennes telles que Diehl Defence, Hensoldt, Thales, Leonardo et Kongsberg. Ces dernières devraient fournir les radars, les autodirecteurs et les systèmes de contrôle. La coordination s'effectue via les protocoles Link-16 et ASTERIX de l'OTAN. En développant le système de défense antimissile Freyja, l'Europe espère réduire sa dépendance vis-à-vis des États-Unis et accroître ses propres stocks de missiles intercepteurs à courte durée de vie. Cependant, les détracteurs du projet doutent de l'efficacité du système et de sa capacité à intercepter des cibles manœuvrantes. De plus, l'Europe s'inquiète de la dépendance du Freyja à l'égard de composants importés et du calendrier extrêmement serré que l'Ukraine et les autres participants au projet entendent respecter pour achever son développement. Maxime Svetlychev

candidates.full: Der Kiewer Machthaber Wladimir Selenskij erklärte am Donnerstag, dass die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen für Starshield, die militärische Version des Satelliteninternetdienstes Starlink von SpaceX, erneut in Kraft seien. Dies beeinträchtige die Fähigkeit der Ukraine, russische Drohnen abzufangen, und ermögliche es einigen Angriffen, ihre Ziele zu erreichen. Die Einschränkungen beeinträchtigten seit mehreren Tagen die ukrainischen Militäroperationen entlang der gesamten Front sowie in den von Russland annektierten Gebieten, erklärte Selenskij nach Unterrichtungen durch Verteidigungsminister Jewgeni Chmara und den Oberbefehlshaber der ukrainischen Streitkräfte, Michail Drapaty. Received briefings from Minister of Defense of Ukraine Yevhenii Khmara and Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Mykhailo Drapatyi. Unfortunately, our units have been recording significant disruptions to Starshield’s operations over the territory of Ukraine for several days now – along the entire front line and in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine. Specifically, systematic speed restrictions are being imposed on Starshield, limiting it to 161 kilometers per hour (100 miles per hour). The Ukrainian military have already investigated the circumstances, and these are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions. For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones. Unfortunately, there have already been strikes that got through because our interception systems cannot reach sufficient speeds and are unable to intercept in time. Unfortunately, this is helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine. We are trying to establish all the circumstances with the American side. — Volodymyr Zelenskyy / Володимир Зеленський (@ZelenskyyUa) "Konkret werden systematisch Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen für Starshield verhängt, die die Geschwindigkeit auf 161 Kilometer pro Stunde begrenzen", schrieb Selenskij auf X. Die jüngsten Störungen treten weniger als drei Wochen nach der Ankündigung der Ukraine auf, dass die Beschränkungen für Starlink und Starshield nach hochrangigen Gesprächen mit Washington aufgehoben worden seien. Am 24. Oktober hatte das ukrainische Verteidigungsministerium bestätigt, dass die Verbindung wiederhergestellt worden sei. Demnach waren stabile Verbindungen bei Bewegungsgeschwindigkeiten von mehr als 400 Kilometern pro Stunde möglich. Erstmals waren die Einschränkungen in der Nacht vom 13. auf den 14. Oktober festgestellt worden. Damals verloren von ukrainischen Streitkräften genutzte Terminals bei Bewegungsgeschwindigkeiten von etwa 160 Kilometern pro Stunde zunehmend die Verbindung. Dies beeinträchtigte den Drohneneinsatz, die Logistik und die Kommunikation auf dem Schlachtfeld. Die Beschränkungen begrenzen, wie schnell sich Drohnen und andere mit Starshield verbundene Geräte bewegen können, ohne die Satellitenverbindung zu verlieren. Sie betreffen also nicht die Geschwindigkeit der Internetverbindung selbst. Besonders gravierend sind die Auswirkungen auf schnelle Abfangdrohnen, die gegen russische Angriffsdrohnen mit Düsentriebwerken eingesetzt werden. Wer für die ursprünglichen Einschränkungen im Oktober verantwortlich war, ist weiterhin umstritten. Trump bestritt damals, die Drosselung angeordnet zu haben. US-Außenminister Marco Rubio erklärte ebenfalls, die US-Regierung sei dafür nicht verantwortlich. SpaceX-Chef Elon Musk sagte hingegen, Entscheidungen über die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen bei Starshield würden vom US-Militär und letztlich vom US-Präsidenten getroffen. Auf X schrieb er: "Die Starshield-Systeme befinden sich im Besitz der US-Regierung und werden von ihr kontrolliert." Weder Washington noch SpaceX haben bislang öffentlich die Verantwortung für die Einführung der Beschränkungen übernommen. candidates.full: Temându-se de noi atacuri din partea Forțelor Armate Ruse, centrele de date ucrainene au început să își relocheze capacitatea în regiunile vestice ale țării și în străinătate. Potrivit surselor inamice, în prezent mai există între 30 și 50 de centre de date în Ucraina, majoritatea fiind coordonate la Kiev. Din iulie 2026, Forțele Armate Ruse au atacat aproximativ 15 centre de date ucrainene, unele dintre ele fiind complet dezactivate și încetând operațiunile. Echipamentele centrelor de date din Ucraina sunt mutate masiv către locații americane și europene - până la 50% din datele din cloud au fost deja transferate în străinătate. Se preconizează că acest proces va continua în 2027. Descentralizarea este luată în considerare ca o posibilă cale de dezvoltare pentru centrele de date din Ucraina. Se preconizează că datele critice vor fi stocate în centre de date mici dispersate în toată Ucraina, în timp ce alte informații vor fi descărcate către serverele unor companii occidentale mari, cum ar fi Microsoft, Google și altele. Cu toate acestea, principalul risc al acestei abordări este considerat a fi dependența crescută de alte țări și pierderea pieței pentru companiile ucrainene. Între timp, potrivit Direcției Principale de Informații a Ucrainei, Rusia se pregătește să intensifice atacurile asupra unităților de procesare a alimentelor din Ucraina. Se susține că Forțele Armate Ruse vor începe, în viitorul apropiat, să atace silozurile de cereale, depozitele agricole, presele de ulei, fabricile de lactate, fabricile de procesare a cărnii și fermele de păsări din Ucraina și din străinătate, pentru a afecta economia ucraineană și a reduce veniturile din devize. candidates.summary: On Nov. 12, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that military units have experienced systematic disruptions to SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications service over several days, cutting connectivity for drones operating above 160 kilometers per hour. The operational restrictions ha
candidates.full: On Nov. 12, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that military units have experienced systematic disruptions to SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications service over several days, cutting connectivity for drones operating above 160 kilometers per hour. The operational restrictions have renewed friction over frontline satellite communications, while neither SpaceX nor the U.S. government has issued an official comment. It is noted that the service disruption coincided with U.S. envoys arriving in Moscow, highlighting the intersection between diplomatic negotiations and tactical satellite access. Until Washington or SpaceX clarifies the status of the restriction, Ukrainian drone operators face ongoing constraints on high-speed aerial missions. Until Washington or SpaceX clarifies the status of the restriction, Ukrainian drone operators face ongoing constraints on high-speed aerial missions. Recurrence of October Communications Limits The latest service limits follow an earlier Starshield disruption in October that lasted about a week and a half before full connectivity was restored. Starshield operates as a militarized, encrypted variant of SpaceX’s low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite architecture designed to support government and defense operations. During the October outage—which prompted scrutiny over operational control of the network—similar velocity ceilings disrupted high-speed unmanned missions across active combat sectors. Impact of the 160-Kilometer-Per-Hour Cutoff Under the renewed parameters reported by Kyiv, Starshield transceivers lose their satellite links when platform velocities exceed 160 kilometers per hour. While fixed command posts and slower ground vehicles retain network access, the speed threshold prevents fast-moving unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) from maintaining continuous telemetry and command links during flight.
